mentions.name: No-code self-hosted compliant database tool
mentions.description: A no-code tool that makes it easy to self-host fully compliant databases with an audit-first approach, letting startups deploy SOC2 compliance-ready databases on their own hardware (e.g., a Hetzner dedicated server) instead of paying cloud providers like AWS RDS to manage the deployment.
mentions.problem: Deploying SOC2-compliant databases through cloud providers is expensive — e.g., $1050/month on AWS RDS versus $55/month for a Hetzner dedicated server with more resources.
mentions.audience: Startups that need SOC2 compliance-ready databases without paying cloud providers for deployment
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a no-code tool to make it easier to self host fully compliant databases with an audit first approach.

evidence.value: Working on a no-code tool to make it easier to self host fully compliant databases with an audit first approach.
